q: By December 31, 2026, the Polish government requests consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty
basis: Poland requested Article 4 consultations after the drone incursion of September 2025. No evidence could be found that it made such a request after the missile crash or the helicopter's violation of its airspace in 2026. A request is likely only after an incident in which people are killed.
rs: An announcement by the Polish government or NATO
